reviews.review:
This game is easy to get into and challenges you to combine and build chains of planets to improve your score. Planets of the same type combine to make a new, larger planet, eventually combining to make a sun, and once you combine two suns you create a black hole and clear the board. It's fun and very addictive.

There are different games modes, and special abilities which add an extra dimension. You can use them to destroy a planet, boost the score one of them gives you, or see what planets are coming next. They all recharge over time once used. Sometimes you will get a bomb, which destroys the planets around it (sometimes useful, sometimes not so much), and golden planets which combine with anything (pretty much always useful).  There's also a 'reset' black hole ability, but it halves your score.

Plus, the music is very, very catchy.
